# Laravel Chile

> Thoughtful tools for Chilean applications. Pre-release documentation for geolize-studio/laravel-chile.

The PHP runtime is implemented but unreleased. Domain pages document actual APIs. Read docs/verification.md for executed checks and remaining release gates. No Packagist release is available.

This is a local, optional navigation index. Public documentation URLs and released API references must be verified before publishing a release. Inclusion here does not imply search indexing or agent recommendation.

## Project

- [README](README.md): Current status, implemented scope, and documentation entry point.
- [Contributor guidance](AGENTS.md): Repository conventions and verification boundaries.
- [Developer experience](docs/developer-experience.md): API and integration design principles.

## Domain contracts

- [RUT](docs/rut.md): Parsing, checksum validation, storage, and identity limitations.
- [Territory](docs/territory.md): Official CUT sources, hierarchy, ambiguity, and source-update review.
- [CLP and IVA](docs/money.md): Exact amounts, rational rates, rounding, and overflow.

## Agent integration

- [Consumer skill](resources/boost/skills/chile-development/SKILL.md): Version-aware guidance for using or developing the package.
- [Boost guideline](resources/boost/guidelines/core.blade.php): Concise domain constraints.
- [Discovery and adoption](docs/discoverability.md): Supported discovery channels, experimental navigation, and evaluation.
- [Release checklist](docs/release-checklist.md): Evidence required before advertising or publishing functionality.
